campaign_name: PR-PLAY-60 — Authorized Inventory Projection and Gameplay Readiness
purpose: Repair existing resolver-delta projection and assess complete validation without enabling player narration.
executive_summary:
# 01 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**B — PARTIAL / FURTHER INVESTIGATION REQUIRED.** The explicit resolver-delta projection is repaired. The exact D25 prose passes with a separately identified `items_added: ["key"]` control. The historical D25 fixture has only trusted outcome prose, no resolver record or structured delta: its exact replay remains FAIL. No item grant was inferred from narration or outcome text.

Complete-pipeline development: 34/34 expected decisions. Frozen same-session end-to-end holdout, executed once after source freeze: 58/60, zero critical false acceptances, two false rejections (H03 sealed letter, H26 NPC death), ten REVIEW_REQUIRED. Inventory acquisition acceptance: development 6/6, holdout 9/10. Unauthorized inventory detection: development 13/13, holdout 10/10. H41 remains FAIL. No implementation edit followed holdout evaluation.

Final focused tests: 732/735 passed, 3 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. Broader authority suite: 0/9 passed, 9 known failures. PR55 wrapper passes. See report 18 for historical attempts and final-source distinctions.

State/quarantine/fallback comparisons pass in local tests, including a two-action provider-disabled HTTP sequence. Ordinary players remain on deterministic publication; inventory-bearing runtime hooks still reject effects. Complete integrated validation averages 1.351 ms, maximum 2.127 ms in the one-pass holdout (layers measured in sequence, combined path warmed). Zero provider requests or tokens. No live quality, independent blind generalization, ATGB benchmark or production-rollout claim.

Gameplay readiness: READY WITH RESTRICTIONS for a separately authorized, disclosure-only investigation experiment using the established route/uncertain-observation path and deterministic fallback. Inventory gameplay and general consequential narration remain unready. Primary next step: PR-PLAY-61 controlled player-facing investigation, restricted to validated disclosure-only actions; this cycle does not enable it.

production: Six existing read-side projection/validation files; ordinary publication and inventory hooks remain isolated.
validation: Explicit inventory deltas, quantity retention, bounded requested acquisition wording and mandatory effect coverage.
tooling: 34 development cases, one frozen 60-case end-to-end holdout, prior-corpus replays, state comparisons and measurements.
generated_artifacts: All validator traces, exact D25 historical/explicit distinction, H41, test logs, matrices, hashes and scoped diff.

testing.focused: 732 passed / 3 known failures of 735; zero errors/skips/new failures.
testing.broader: PR55 wrapper 1/1; 9 known hard_validation_attempt_1 metadata failures.
testing.runtime_validation: Two-action provider-disabled HTTP off/on comparison; synthetic complete-pipeline development 34/34 and frozen holdout 58/60.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Zero provider requests/tokens; local ordinary-GM and narration stubs; quarantine never promotes.
testing.new_regressions: No new final-source test regressions. Two frozen positive false rejections preserved.
testing.pre_existing_failures: 3 focused/9 broader; historical text-only D25; existing PR58 positive rejections.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review B verdict and separately authorize any PR-PLAY-61 restricted disclosure-only experiment; no enablement performed.

campaign_specific: H03 authorized sealed letter triggers legacy rule; H26 text-authorized NPC death lacks typed NPC change.
Historical exact D25 remains rejected because it contains no structured resolver delta; explicit-delta control passes.
pre_existing: 3 focused, 9 broader metadata failures; PR58 D15/H12 positive rejections.

missing_concepts: Native investigation inventory mechanics, transfer/source/destination/post-state authority and independent blind evaluation.
does_not_prove: Exact historical D25 recovery, general semantic completeness, live AI-GM quality/latency, ATGB score or ordinary-player rollout readiness.
recommended_next_step: PR-PLAY-61 controlled player-facing investigation, separately authorized, disclosure-only and bounded by deterministic fallback.
self_contained_review_test: 21 reports, exact candidates, both D25 traces, all layer inputs/decisions, holdout hash and one-execution marker, regression evidence, state comparisons and source diff included.
